fluff.overview: Word of Blake Militia infantry served as the backbone of Protectorate garrison forces across dozens of conquered worlds, providing the manpower for territorial control that the Militia's BattleMech and armor assets could not sustain alone. Mechanized wheeled Level I formations used wheeled APCs for efficient patrol and garrison operations on developed worlds within the Protectorate. Their lower maintenance burden compared to tracked or hover transports made them the most common mechanized infantry type in the Word of Blake Militia's order of battle. Carrying infantry-portable long-range missile systems that extend the platoon's engagement envelope well beyond personal weapon range, these troops provide indirect fire support that can suppress enemy positions from distances where return fire is difficult.
